flow.object: triangulated surface; link LENGTHS w (Ni-Lin-Gao-Gu 2019 convention)
flow.transport: lazy walk: stay alpha = 0.5, hop to neighbour z with prob (1-alpha) exp(-w_xz^2)/sum (p = 2)
flow.curvature: Ollivier-Ricci kappa = 1 - W1(m_x, m_y)/w_xy, exact W1 by linear programming, ground cost = shortest paths with the current lengths
flow.step: w <- w - eps * kappa * w, eps = 0.5; then rescale to the initial total length (normalised flow); no surgery
flow.eye_hopping: balls for the eye hop with T_e = exp(1 - w_e^2) (same kernel), thermal beta 1 mu 0 (L1 eye, THR2 from L1 calibration)
flow.holonomy: nearest feasible check of the orb_core spinor test (that one needs a lattice symmetry; a weighted graph has none): Regge geometry of the triangulation, deficit delta_v = 2pi - sum of corner angles (law of cosines from the lengths). Spinor around v multiplied by exp(i sigma_z delta_v/2). N_inv = 2 if every |delta_v| < 0.05 rad, else 0. Cycle holonomy of the torus not computed (for an exactly flat closed orientable surface it is trivial, Bieberbach).

starts.a: hex torus L = 15 (225 v, 675 e), w = 1 + 0.4 U(-1,1), seed default_rng(20261050)
starts.b: random geometric triangulation of a flat 60-deg torus: 225 uniform points, periodic Delaunay, ALL lengths start at 1 (only the links are kept, the drawn positions are forgotten); seeds 20261051, 20261052. Deviation from 'radius graph': a radius RGG is not a surface mesh, Regge holonomy needs triangles.
starts.c: sphere: 225 uniform points on S^2, convex hull triangulation, all lengths 1; seeds 20261053, 20261054
starts.z3: hex torus L = 15, w_e = 1 + 0.2 f(midpoint), f(x) = sum_k cos(b_k . x), b_k the 3 shortest reciprocal vectors of the L-torus (120 deg related): extrema exactly at the 3 fixed points of the 120 deg rotation (0,0), (5,5), (10,10). No noise. Not a quotient.

exams.a_b_spread: S = std of kappa over edges; PASS if S_final <= S_initial / 10
exams.a_b_eye: final MI read by the eye: loops == 2 AND cones == 0 AND cavities == 1 (cavity graded 'if feasible': reported separately)
exams.c: PASS if mean kappa_final > 0 for both sphere seeds AND min over sphere seeds of mean kappa_final > max over torus (b) seeds of mean kappa_final (sphere rounder than the flat reference). Holonomy N_inv expected 0 (Gauss-Bonnet: sum delta = 4 pi always: a trivial consequence, not evidence). Eye: cavities 1, loops 0 reported.
exams.z3: concentration C = sum_{v within 1 hop of the 3 fixed points} |delta_v| / sum_v |delta_v| (area baseline 21/225 = 0.093); same for |vertex Ollivier curvature|. Verdict 'cone-like' if C_final >= 0.5 AND eye cones == 3 within 1 hop of the 3 fixed points; 'washed out' if max|delta|_final <= max|delta|_initial / 10; else 'neither'. Reported either way; no tuning.

L2.go_no_go: GO for a bigger emergence study only if L1 passes AND (a) passes all three exams AND z3 is 'cone-like'. Otherwise NO-GO with the reason.
